ops.body: Shipped in commit 04865f4ce237: athome/research/procs.py — append-only procs.jsonl registry under the campaign root (register before launch, bind pid/pgid on spawn, terminal once spend enters the accounting stream); ClaudeCodeDriver hooks; meta.run_campaign startup scan refuses on live orphans and unreconciled latches (dead orphans get the experiment abort latch + terminal mark); watchdog.check_campaign + 'athome research meta watch' run the same scan under a momentary LOCK_EX|NB when no runner holds the campaign lock. 14 tests in tests/test_research_procs.py with injected pid liveness.
